pickups.title: FORGE
pickups.description: Store 2 or 3 matching POINTS or TIER ingredients to activate at ×4 or ×8 strength. The first ingredient sets the strength.

pickups.title: POINTS
pickups.description: Score immediately unless TIER is active. With TIER, accumulate upgraded points and bank when its strength runs out. More distant pickups give higher-tier points.

pickups.title: + SIGN
pickups.description: Convert pending points to positive, keeping the negative-sign bonus. Does not bank early: finish charging TIER to score.

pickups.title: - SIGN
pickups.description: Make the active TIER chain negative and double subsequent POINTS values. The bonus does not stack and survives +SIGN. Convert before the final POINT or bank a negative total!

pickups.title: TIER
pickups.description: Upgrade the next POINTS pickups by one tier. Strength determines how many pickups charge before banking. A new TIER replaces remaining strength without changing accumulated points.

pickups.title: ECHO
pickups.description: Double the next POINTS reward or TIER strength. Can be armed before a chain; does not stack. SIGN does not consume it.

pickups.title: ALL-IN
pickups.description: Double the pot. The next shell must provide POINTS and banks immediately, bypassing FORGE storage; anything else loses the chain.

pickups.title: INVERSION
pickups.description: Flip the chain's sign and double its accumulated pot. Rescue a negative pot or risk turning positive points negative; convert before banking.
